A '''facility''', located off [[Ore Boulevard]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[ChikatLik]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Cestus/Legends|Ord Cestus]], was managed by the [[X'Ting]] [[Crime lord/Legends|gang leader]] [[Trillot]], as part of the wider [[Tenloss Syndicate/Legends|Tenloss Syndicate]]. An oval-shaped [[Iron/Legends|iron]] door was the entrance to the facility, in a shadowed corridor directly off Ore Boulevard.
